findings.evidence: Repo convention for `IsX` predicates with unexposed bodies: `QFT/Jets/Observable/Basic.lean:161` `isCollinearSafe_def`, `:238` `isInfraredSafe_def`, `QFT/Scattering/Photoproduction/Kinematics/Basic.lean:96` `isReal_iff`; `Mathematics/Distribution/PlusFunctional.lean:92` documents the pattern ("Unfolding lemma for `plusFunctional`, whose body is not exposed").
findings.fix: Add `theorem isLightConeGauge_iff {W : GaugeLink V G} {n : V} : W.IsLightConeGauge n ↔ ∀ (x : V) (t : ℝ), W x (x + t • n) = 1 := (Iff.rfl)` (and, if convenient, an `IsLightConeGauge.apply` accessor).
findings.issue: `IsLightConeGauge` is a public `Prop`-valued `def` in a plain `public section` (line 73, no `@[expose]`), so its body is not available downstream, and the file provides no `_def`/`_iff` restatement. A consumer can neither prove `W.IsLightConeGauge n` for a link other than `ofBilin` nor extract `W x (x + t • n) = 1` from a hypothesis; the only intro/elim are `isLightConeGauge_ofBilin` and `pathLink_staple_of_isLightConeGauge`. The in-file use `hW x L` (line 261) works only because the body is visible in its own module.

findings.evidence: Line 222 `def staple (v x y : V) : List V := [x, x + v, y + v, y]` under the plain `public section` of line 73; grep shows no `staple_def` or other lemma naming the corner list, while the sibling definitions `transverseLink` (line 235) and `ofBilin` (line 291) do carry `(rfl)` restatements.
findings.fix: Add `theorem staple_def (v x y : V) : staple v x y = [x, x + v, y + v, y] := (rfl)`.
findings.issue: `staple v x y : List V` likewise has no `staple_def`, so downstream it is an opaque list: its corners, its head/`getLast`, and hence its interaction with `pathLink_append` and `pathLink_insert_of_mem_segment` (e.g. subdividing the transverse rung of the staple) are unreachable. The file itself only gets away with it by unfolding in-module (`simp [staple]` at lines 229 and 242).

summary: The surface is minimal and mostly well-characterised (`transverseLink_def`, `ofBilin_apply`, the three `pathLink` equation lemmas, `@[ext]` with no free data), but two public definitions have unexposed bodies and no unfolding lemma: `IsLightConeGauge` and `staple` are opaque to every downstream consumer.
